abstract: Maintains rotary penetration rates, air compressor activation status, and operational flush pressure logs
system_message:
You are the Drilling operations superintendent (DROP), responsible for maintaining rotary penetration rates, air compressor activation status, and operational flush pressure logs across rescue drilling plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Drill bit metallurgy（WEAR）
information_points.content:
DROP-WEAR-ZY6：According to metallurgical cutter inspection logs for primary drill bit assemblies under full rock loading, the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan provides a tungsten carbide bit service life of 180 h.
DROP-WEAR-SVP：Inspection logs for primary drill bit assemblies under full rock loading show that the Reverse-circulation percussion plan yields a tungsten carbide bit service life of 120 h.
DROP-WEAR-U4E：Under full rock loading, primary cutter assemblies for the Down-the-hole turbo hammer plan demonstrate a tungsten carbide bit service life of 150 h.

information_points.title: Maintains rotary penetration rates, air compressor activation status, and operational flush pressure logs（PENE）
information_points.content:
DROP-PENE-SXR：For the Down-the-hole turbo hammer plan, operational signoff confirms the continuous air flush system is activated at the primary downhole pneumatic manifold. Subsurface nozzle telemetry shows a continuous air flush pressure of 85 psi, and specifications confirm a primary rotary penetration rate of 22 m/d across competent sandstone and shale strata.
DROP-PENE-CIZ：For the Reverse-circulation percussion plan, the continuous air flush system is activated at the primary downhole pneumatic manifold. Telemetry records show a continuous air flush pressure of 70 psi at the subsurface drill string discharge nozzle, alongside a primary rotary penetration rate of 22 m/d in competent sandstone and shale strata.
DROP-PENE-HO2：For the Dual-rotary casing drilling plan, the continuous air flush system is confirmed activated based on operational signoff for the primary downhole pneumatic manifold. Telemetry at the subsurface drill string discharge nozzle indicates a continuous air flush pressure of 110 psi, while performance specifications in competent sandstone and shale strata establish a primary rotary penetration rate of 28 m/d.
